reviews.comment: Such an incredible teacher and awesome guy. Super accommodating and caring about his students success, development, understanding, and time. He gives the best lectures and you can tell that he is truly passionate about his work and the class content. He makes the lectures fun and interactive and he has a strong sense of humor. Great class.

Professor Sarathi is one of those rare professors that actually cares about your development as a student. He is so passionate and engaging that the lectures don't even feel like lectures. The grading is relatively easy, and if you put in the effort, you will do well. Highly recommend.

He is so nice and funny! There was a lot of writing, but follow the rubrics and you should be fine. The in classwork was easy, but make sure to go so u can do them. No exams, just one project that is pretty easy and creative. Gave lots of extra credit and opportunities for points back. Highly recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: There were no exams but be ready to have a lot of homework each week. While the assignments weren't hard, it was hard to find time to sit down and watch the documentary at times. Grading was clear and extra credit was offered throughout, so if you're a decent writer an A should be very achievable.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class was very easy for the most part. No exams, but A disussion and short answer every week. He gives a lot of extra credit and made the class easier as the semester went on. Took this class online.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great guy who is really funny. No exams, two short papers a week, one in class assignment each week, one end of year project that could be basically whatever you wanted it to be. Overall, very easy A but could give students who are bad at/don't like writing a harder time.

Great professor and really great guy, I often submitted assignments late, to which he offered me extensions. He's also really funny and seems to care a lot about what he's teaching and the students in his class. I would honestly take this class all over again just to learn more from him. 10/10

This class exceeded my expectations i had thought it would just be a bunch of reading, but He always made the lecture interesting when talking about his personal experiences, and He has great jokes :)
Nice guy. Lots of extra credit. He was handling a lot this semester but managed to keep up, I think. Could have got grades faster. Documentary's were amazing.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I heard he's leaving TAMU so I wanted to leave a reviw. I was going to take him in the fall. Really great prof who clearly cares about his work. Very funny and handles sensitive topics well. Lectures, documentary, and the textbook each week can get a bit much with all the writing, so I dropped him down to a 4/5. No exams.

Really funny! Gives you extensions for any reason, which is nice. Lots of writing, which was boring and the only downside. My favorite moment was when he forgot Timothee Chalamet's name and called him “the guy who looks like a triangle.”

There was no textbook, only lectures and a weekly documentary. He dropped the course load by about half in the middle of the semester, which was a HUGE relief. He's really nice and tries to get the class to engage. Makes really corny dad jokes. Interesting topics and he handles sensitive stuff really well. TA sucked, but that's not on him.

Understanding professor who makes himself accessible, but very boring. Lectures feel very long. Show up to class as there are weekly assignments only given to those that show up. Beware of hour-long documentaries you have to watch EVERY WEEK (heard his 204 class only has to read short articles -_-), not hard, but time-consuming and tedious.
Great professor that genuinely cares about the students. Super engaging with the class and just an overall great professor.
Easy, easy class! Very funny guy and the class really opens your thoughts. Excellent professor.
Professor Sarathi makes his lectures interesting and is passionate about what he teaches. I recommend taking him if you are able to as the work is manageable and the expectations are clear.

Very easy-going professor, who cares about his students. 
Show up to class/in-class assignments. 
Two assignments a week.: very easy, just follow the rubric. 
Let me redo a couple of assignments. 
No final exam.
very easy class, just put in the effort and don't skip.

He's a great teacher! He really cares about students and he's hilarious! No textbook and no exams, only essay assignments every week and a project. Follow his rubrics for an A because he's a little obsessive about them. I'm taking him again next semester for Anth 201. The only downside is that his lecture slides have a LOT of information on them.

You must write two short papers a week. Very easy, but grading depends on the TA. Interesting lectures and no tests. Show up to class for extra credit. One major project, but follow the directions and you'll get a good grade.

I've had Dr. A the last 2 semesters for different classes, and I love him so much. He remembers names and seems genuinely excited to see you in class. He's hilarious and his lectures are interesting. Grading is clear and easy, and no exams.
The nicest professor at TAMU. Take him!!!! Easy going class. He cares for his students. He is HILARIOUS. literally so funny and the best lectures.

I took him for ANTH 204 and he was great! Assignments consisted of one in class assignment and two assignments that were done outside of class. Lectures are recorded and you only go to class for the in class assignment which counts also as attendance. Extra credit is provided, and helps a lot! He's also super funny and friendly as well.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Easily one of my favorite professors by far. There are no exams in this class, just two assignments each week, with a little effort you get full credit. There is this project due towards the end of the semester, but it is an easy 100 if you put forth the effort. No reason to not get above a 100 in this class. His lectures are really entertaining.

It wouldn't allow me to choose ANTH 204 on here but that was the class I took this semester. Very funny, relatable, and engaging professor. Weekly assignments are based off an online lecture, possible documentary, and an article to analyze. Assignments are not difficult but I found doing the same 3 things every week became 'hard'. Fun class though.

I enjoyed taking Dr.Sarathi's class. We only had class on Thursdays, and he occasionally canceled. Thursday classes are mandatory because you do in class assignments that are a big part of your grade. He has a very specific personality and is sarcastic, but nothing that students couldn't handle. Overall pretty easy class, would recommend!
Akshay is a great professor. He does not use exams and instead has you write a few essays every week. Lectures are important and sometimes he gives out extra credit for attending.

ANTH204: TThr class, but we only met on Thr. which was nice. You can't miss, as the weekly assignment is a group project in class every week. Every Saturday you have two small essays due, which aren't hard, just tedious. He is very kind and intelligent and an overall great prof, just expects you to care about ANTH as much as him, which is hard.

AMAZING prof!!!! Genuinely made me enjoy anthropology, so much that I'm taking him again next semester. Literally impossible to fail if you do all of the assignments. No tests or quizzes. TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN!!!!!!

No exams, but there are two weekly short essay assignments, plus a major project. Grading criteria for weekly essays felt a little inconsistent, but overall this was a great class. Dr. A is passionate and that shows in his very engaging lectures. I liked the creative choice allowed in the final project. Take this prof unless you don't like essays.

Dr. A is a good professor and his lectures are very interesting, but my problem comes in with the weekly assignments. Personally, I was jumping from getting 60s and 70s one week to 100s other weeks for what I thought was the same quality of work. It made it very confusing, but he did leave good feedback on all assignments, including projects.
Attendance is graded, however there is so much extra credit. Very good prof, truly cares and wants to have students engage in the material. Very easy and neat material.

He is amazing! He takes attendance every day, but it really does not matter because his class is something I look forward to. He does a great job at keeping the lecture entertaining and tries to make it easy for everyone to receive an A. Highly recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Sarathi gives very interesting lectures and is a very caring professor. Be sure to pay attention in his class, as the work is not too difficult as long as you do so.

Dr. Sarathi was amazing and I even looked forward to his class. His project is the biggest grade and is really fun and pretty easy. He doesn't have many grading criteria. No final exam and ended class early alot. There's HW each week but it's easy and he will let you know exactly what to work on. I wish I could take him each semester he's so cool.
Super interesting assignments and a great professor. Offers extra credit. You'd have to make an effort to get a B.

Super easy class just make sure to show up since he does give out worksheets that you have to turn in each week. Assignments are not hard at all, 2 assignments each week for each unit. No final exam, just an essay/project with a lot of freedom. Would have gotten an A but I had the class at 8 AM and missed a couple of worksheets lol.

I had Dr. Sarathi for ANTH204, not 201 - I couldn't select 204 for some reason. 

My experience with Dr. Sarathi was amazing!!! No tests, just weekly groupwork questions based on lecture material and a few documentaries or articles (to be consumed outside of class). He was very knowledgeable, nice, funny, & offered extra credit. 10/10 recommend!

GO OUT OF YOUR WAY TO TAKE SARATHI!!! He is by far the best professor I have ever had, the coursework is very manageable, two assignments per week with no tests and a final project. Please take this class, not just because it's an easy A but because of Dr A. I genuinely can't say enough how amazing of a man he is; lectures are easy and informative.

There were three exams and they were all open notes/take-home. There was a discussion post due every Saturday that you needed to refer to the book/notes about it. Attendance was not mandatory BUT definitely go. It was very interesting and all the test questions come from his lecture/book. WOULD TAKE AGAIN 100%, best professor here.

Dr. Sarathi makes this class always fun. Exams were given out, and you didn't have to go to class but I enjoyed it except for some topics like gender studies. You can be comfortable in class and he encourages you to participate.

Professor was very enjoyable and funny. Class was set up in a way where you were almost guaranteed an A if you at least tried to do the work (which was very easy). He offered a very short 500 word extra credit essay worth 50 points (tests were 100 points) which easily will boost your grade if you need it. Class was fun, easy, and interesting!

Professor Sarathi really taught the class well. I do have to say I didn't go to class as much due to attendance not being mandatory. Grades consist of weekly discussions where you have to write 150 words and respond to others in 50 words. Other than that we had three exams, which were take home, and a final paper. There's also an extra credit essay

Holy crap take this class even if it's not required. The prof is so funny and sweet. Top 3 teacher from kindergarten up. Exams are online, open note. Lectures are funny and not attendance based, although the prof will have you waking up early to go just for a good laugh. Plenty of extra credit opportunities, and lectures are often canceled. Take!!

Dr. S is one of the best teachers I have ever had. He is such a caring professor and understand any circumstance. His lectures are personal, interesting and filled with jokes here and there. If you have the chance to take Dr. S do it! You won't regret it. He offers a ton of extra credit and the workload is not much.

Dr. Sarathi is an amazing prof who deeply cares for his students. He is hilarious and loves getting to know students on a personal basis. Tests are online and if you pay attention in lectures, you will do good on tests.

Dr. A was one of my best professors this semester. Very easy class material, take-home tests, and hilarious lectures made this class a must-take. He genuinely cares about his students and he wants everyone to succeed. The guest lectures gave new insight and material and were a fun bonus. Would highly recommend taking his anthropology classes!

He was awesome! TA's grade everything but mine were pretty chill. He just lectures and talks all class long but everyone is interactive so it was entertaining. Take home tests were pretty nice too! Overall super chill and cool class and it's not hard to do well

Prof Sarathi is an amazing professor! He truly cares about his students. There are discussion posts due weekly and the tests are on paper and open note. Attendance is not graded, but I highly recommend attending lectures because the discussion posts are sometimes based on the lecture. The exams are based on the textbook and some of the lectures

This class was very good and interesting. The classwork is pretty fine with discussion posts every week, and The exams and discussion posts draw from the lectures he gives in class, so don't skip days. He also gives lots of documentaries to watch for schoolwork, which is a nice change of pace from other classes, Highly recommend.

I personally loved this Professor the lectures were always very interesting, and he made sure to always keep the class interactive and lively with discussions. Wasn't a lot of work he gave if you made time to actually start on it and not wait till the end. Exams and discussions mostly included you to buy the textbook for some of the readings.
